{{Quote|The Empire has discovered us, though I don't know how! Evacuation is priority one, and securing as much of this equipment as we can is secondary. We're scrambling fighters to buy us time, but we don't have much either way!|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Ran Niall]]|<ref name="OAA" />}}
The '''Battle of the Gauntlet''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on [[Arda I]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Aftermath==
[[File:Jumpintoaction-OaAI.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Imperial stormtroopers deploy from an AT-AT into the battle.]]
{{Quote|We lost a great deal today: our base, our home, and our friends. We must look past these dark times and steel ourselves for the fight ahead.|Senior Advisor Setenna Hase|<ref name="OAA" />}}
After the evacuation of [[Arda Base]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] embarked in a series of micro-jumps through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to throw off any pursuit. They finally regrouped in the [[Eedoq system/Legends|Eedoq system]], in the distant [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra sector]], where [[Senior Advisor/Legends|Senior Advisor]] [[Setenna Hase]] came aboard the Rebel [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Fury of Alderaan]]'' to discuss the establishment of a [[Resolute Base|new base]] on [[Jagomir]].
